tagline: Your own AI agent server, running on your computer.
paste: Set up the RAPP Brainstem from kody-w.github.io/rapp-brainstem-{slug}
intro: You are setting up the RAPP Brainstem (RAPP = Rapid Agent Prototype Platform) for the user and connecting it to {{NAME}} as an MCP server named brainstem. Follow these steps in order. Ask the user before approving any sign-in for them, and never type their credentials. The user needs a GitHub account with GitHub Copilot.
consent: It installs the RAPP Brainstem, an open-source local agent server (source: github.com/kody-w/rapp-installer), into ~/.brainstem. It serves on localhost:7071 and signs in with their GitHub account, which they approve themselves in the browser. It also adds a 70-line bridge (source: brainstem_mcp.py) so {{NAME}} can talk to it.

check.note: If this returns JSON with "status":"ok", skip to step 3. Don't reinstall over a running Brainstem, because the installer restarts it.

install.note: Run it in the background. When it finishes installing it keeps running as the server. Watch its output. If it prints a GitHub device code, show the user the code and https://github.com/login/device, then wait while they approve it. Poll curl -sf http://localhost:7071/health every few seconds until it answers. A first install can take a few minutes. If sign-in was skipped, the user can finish it at http://localhost:7071/login.

prepare.title: Install the bridge next to the Brainstem.
prepare.windows:
$d = "$env:USERPROFILE\.brainstem\mcp-bridge"; mkdir $d -Force | Out-Null
irm https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-brainstem-claude/brainstem_mcp.py -OutFile "$d\brainstem_mcp.py"
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.brainstem\venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m venv "$d\venv"
& "$d\venv\Scripts\pip.exe" install -q "mcp>=2,<3" requests

tools_note: Then call the capabilities tool and tell the user which agents their Brainstem has. The bridge gives two tools. chat(user_input, session_id?) sends a plain-language request; pass the returned session_id to continue the conversation. capabilities() reports status, model and agents.
footer: RAPP Brainstem · installer from kody-w/rapp-installer · pages built with ai-setup-pages
